Key Improvements

📐 Consistent Spacing
4px base unit creates visual rhythm and harmony throughout the interface.
/* Spacing Scale */ --space-1: 0.25rem; // 4px --space-2: 0.5rem; // 8px --space-3: 0.75rem; // 12px --space-4: 1rem; // 16px
✨ Smooth Animations
Custom easing curves create natural, polished motion.
/* Easing */ --ease-out: cubic-bezier( 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1 ) /* Duration */ Fast: 150ms Normal: 200ms Slow: 300ms
🖱️ Interactive Buttons
Tactile feedback with lift on hover and scale on press.

Try hovering and clicking

🎭 Subtle Shadows
Layered shadows create depth without looking dated.
/* Shadow System */ --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px
